summary: Interacting with certain villagers with the villager trade rebalance enabled causes client crash
description: When interacting with a villager with the villager trade rebalance enabled, if that villager s career and level could generate ItemAndEmeraldsToItems type trades that sell enchanted items (e.g. plains armorer), then the game will crash. To reproduce: - Create a new world. Make sure the villager trade rebalance is enabled. - Level an armorer up to either expert (does not apply to expert level taiga villagers) or master level. - Save and quit the world. - Reopen the world. - Interact with the armorer. - The game will crash. I ve also attached both a crash report from a vanilla client and one that is deobfuscated with the official mappings.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new world with the villager trade rebalance enabled.
2. Level an armorer villager up to either expert or master level.
3. Save and quit the world.
4. Reopen the world.
5. Interact with the armorer villager.
6. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior: When interacting with certain villagers while the villager trade rebalance is enabled, the game crashes if the villager's career and level could lead to trades involving enchanted items, such as those offered by a plains armorer. To reproduce this issue, players should create a new world with the villager trade rebalance enabled, then level an armorer to either expert or master level, noting that this issue does not apply to expert-level taiga villagers. After saving and quitting the world, reopening it, and interacting with the armorer, the game will crash. This behavior has been documented in both a crash report from a vanilla client and a deobfuscated version using official mappings, providing developers with the necessary information to investigate and address the issue effectively.
Expected Behavior: When interacting with a villager with the villager trade rebalance enabled, the expected behavior is that the game should allow the player to trade without any crashes occurring. Specifically, when the player levels an armorer to either expert or master level and subsequently interacts with that villager, the player should be able to view available trades, including those for enchanted items, without experiencing any disruptions or client crashes. The game should function smoothly, maintaining stability and allowing for a seamless trading experience.
